iso_retirement.comment:
The name Kohoroxitari is the name of a village of speakers of the Yanoma (or
possibly the Xitari) dialect of Sanuma. It is a place name, rather than the name
of a distinct (and mutually unintelligible) language variety. Kohoroxitari has
been listed in the Ethnologue as "unclassified."
iso_retirement.name: Kohoroxitari
iso_retirement.remedy: Merge into [xsu], Sanuma. Name now identified as a village name, not a language name.
